rules.text: "Anti" combination: considered bad, creates struggle in life

source.quote: some combinations of Mulank and Bhagyank are considered as bad and can create struggle

rules.say: Your psychic number (Mulank) and destiny number (Bhagyank) form an 'anti' combination, which is considered unfavourable and can create struggle in life.

rules.text: Remedies: (1) Kumbh Vivah; (2) chant the Venus (Shukra) mantra "Himakunda mrinalabham..." 108 times - wake 3:40 am (Brahma muhurta), bathe, wear white, puja at home mandir sitting on floor, bow to Venus; (3) name correction "as per the chart"; (4) wear an opal

source.quote: Some anti-number combinations give struggle in relationships

rules.condition: anti pair AND struggle in relationships
rules.say: If this number combination brings struggles in relationships, suggested remedies are Kumbh Vivah, chanting the Venus (Shukra) mantra 108 times at dawn, a name correction, or wearing an opal.

rules.text: Remedies: (1) name correction "is Must"; (2) donations for good karma; (3) wear a number "24" gold pendant; (4) wear 7 Mukhi + 6 Mukhi Rudraksha together; (5) chant Sarva Karya Siddhi mantra 108 times daily

source.quote: In this case Name Correction is Must.

rules.condition: anti pair AND struggle in career (business / foreign settlement / daily life)
rules.say: If this combination brings struggles in career, business or settling abroad, a name correction is a must; donations, a gold '24' pendant, 7 and 6 Mukhi Rudraksha together, and the Sarva Karya Siddhi mantra help.

rules.text: Remedies: (1) keep 1/2 kg lapis lazuli in bedroom; (2) Dhanwantari Yantra ("as discussed in Yantra Class"); (3) Maha Mrityunjay jaap if the issue is very big

source.quote: Keep ½ Kg Lapis Lazuli Stone in your Bedroom.

rules.condition: anti pair AND struggle in health
rules.say: If this combination brings health struggles, keeping lapis lazuli in your bedroom and the Dhanwantari Yantra are suggested, with Maha Mrityunjay jaap for bigger issues, alongside proper medical care.

rules.text: "Opposite numbers": not anti/enemy; no special remedy; read the Lo-Shu grid, adjust name spelling, suggest missing-number remedies, as the person wants

source.quote: not exactly anti or enemy of each other but considered as Opposite Numbers

rules.say: Your psychic and destiny numbers are 'opposite numbers', not enemies, and need no special remedy. If you wish, your Lo Shu grid, name spelling and missing numbers can be looked at.
